title: Navigation script without Freeze Window
description: Performance rule — scripts with several layout switches or Go to Related Record steps and no Freeze Window repaint the screen on every hop. Freeze Window suppresses the intermediate renders; FileMaker refreshes automatically when the script ends.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Every layout switch without a frozen window triggers a full render of the intermediate context — visible flicker at best, layout-triggered evaluations and record loads at worst. A single Freeze Window before the navigation sequence suppresses all of it.
rule.remediation: Add Freeze Window before the first navigation step. Scripts that run server-side (see the PSoS column) have no window to freeze — treat those rows as context, not defects. Other legitimate exceptions: scripts whose intermediate layouts are meant to be seen.

meta.description: Counts enabled Go to Layout (6) and Go to Related Record (74) steps per script; scripts at or above the threshold without any enabled Freeze Window (79) are reported. The threshold is a heuristic — hence severity info. The called-via-PSoS column marks scripts referenced by a Perform Script on Server step (context, not an exclusion: a script can be called both ways).
